info.name: Lago API documentation Add_ons Invoices API

params.name: page
params.description: Page number.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of records per page.

params.name: external_customer_id
params.description: Unique identifier assigned to the customer in your application.

params.name: issuing_date_from
params.description: Filter invoices starting from a specific date.

params.name: issuing_date_to
params.description: Filter invoices up to a specific date.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter invoices by status. Possible values are `draft` or `finalized`.

params.name: payment_status
params.description: Filter invoices by payment status. Possible values are `pending`, `failed` or `succeeded`.

params.name: payment_overdue
params.description: Filter invoices by payment_overdue. Possible values are `true` or `false`.

params.name: search_term
params.description: Search invoices by id, number, customer name, customer external_id or customer email.

params.name: currency
params.description: Filter invoices by currency in. Possible values ISO 4217 currency codes.

params.name: payment_dispute_lost
params.description: Filter invoices with a payment dispute lost. Possible values are `true` or `false`.

params.name: invoice_type
params.description: Filter invoices by invoice type. Possible values are `subscription`, `add_on`, `credit`, `one_off` or `advance_charges`
